en.apartments.cosy_couple_nest.descripti: A cozy double bed for couples or solo travelers.
en.apartments.cosy_couple_nest.long_desc:
Welcome to the Cosy Couple Nest, your cozy retreat in the heart of Vienna. This charming apartment offers a comfortable double bed, ideal for couples or solo travelers who value peace and comfort.

The living area invites you to relax with a modern TV – perfect for movie nights or unwinding after an exciting day. Thanks to the fast, free WiFi, you stay connected at all times, whether for work or leisure.

The fully equipped kitchen includes everything you need for self-catering: fridge, kettle, microwave, cooking facilities, and plenty of dishes. You can easily prepare your favorite meals.

The modern bathroom with shower ensures a refreshing start to the day or relaxing moments in the evening.

The Cosy Couple Nest: small, charming, and perfect for your stay in Vienna.
en.apartments.cosy_couple_nest.name: Cosy Couple Nest

Welcome to the Duo Deluxe Studio – your stylish home away from home in Vienna. This modern studio offers a comfortable double bed, ideal for couples or solo travelers who appreciate design and functionality.

The living area is equipped with a high-quality TV, allowing you to enjoy relaxing evenings with your favorite movies or series. The fast, free WiFi ensures you stay perfectly connected at all times.

The well-equipped kitchen includes everything you need for self-catering: fridge, kettle, microwave, cooking facilities, and plenty of dishes. You can prepare your meals just the way you like them.

The modern bathroom with shower provides comfort and refreshment after a long day in the city.

The Duo Deluxe Studio: stylish, modern, and perfect for your stay in Vienna.

en.instructions.checkin.quote1: To check in to your apartment, you will find a keypad to the left of the entrance door, where you can enter your access code.
en.instructions.checkin.quote2: First, press the "power key" on the keyboard to activate it. Then enter the access code that you received from us.
en.instructions.checkin.quote3: Once the code is entered correctly, a red dot will light up, indicating that the door is unlocked.
en.instructions.checkin.quote4: Turn the door knob to the left to unlock the door. Since this is a security door, it may feel a bit heavy when opening. Make sure to pull it firmly toward you after turning the knob.
en.instructions.checkin.quote5: After entering the building, take the elevator to the floor where your apartment is located.
en.instructions.checkin.quote6: Next to your apartment door, you will find a key box. Enter the code for the key box, press the lever down, and retrieve the key.
en.instructions.ironing.quote1: The iron and ironing board are located on the ground floor of the apartment building. From the main entrance, walk straight ahead, past the elevator, and you'll find the ironing board mounted on the left side.
en.instructions.ironing.quote2: Fold down the ironing board: Turn the hook on the right side of the ironing board to the right to release the lock. Gently fold the ironing board down until it is level.
en.instructions.ironing.quote3:
Prepare an iron: Plug the iron into the power outlet. If necessary, add water to the iron to use the steam function.

Ironing: Set the desired temperature on the iron and wait until it heats up. Iron your clothes on the ironing board.

After use: Turn off the iron, unplug it and let it cool down. Flip the ironing board back up and turn the hook to the left to secure it.
en.instructions.parking.heading: Parking options and tips for your stay
en.instructions.parking.quote1:
Underground parking

Our underground car park is ideal for smaller cars up to the size of a VW Golf. Since the door has to be opened manually, you need to make a reservation in advance and we need your approximate time of arrival to let you in. Parking costs 10€ per day for cars and 5€ per day for motorbikes. Bicycles can be parked free of charge.
en.instructions.parking.quote2:
Public parking

Public parking spaces are available around our accommodation. These are chargeable during the week from 9:00 to 22:00, but offer free parking at night from 22:00 to 9:00. On weekends, you can park for free all day long. You can easily buy parking tickets via the mobile app "EasyPark".
en.instructions.checkout.text1: We hope you had a pleasant stay! Before you leave, please follow these steps to help us prepare for our next guests:
en.instructions.checkout.quote1:
Collect used towels:

Collect all used towels and place them on the floor in the bathroom. That way we know which towels need to be changed.
en.instructions.checkout.quote2:
Switch off devices & close windows:

Please turn off all electrical appliances (TV, kitchen utensils, etc.) and check that all windows are properly closed. This helps us save energy and ensure safety.
en.instructions.checkout.quote3:
Return key:

Please put the key back in the key box in front of the apartment door and lock the box securely.
en.instructions.checkout.quote4:
Additional instructions:

- Please wash any dishes you've used before checking out. This helps us speed up the cleaning process. Thank you for your cooperation!

- Let us know when you've checked out so we can prepare the apartment for the next guests. We really appreciate your help!
en.instructions.checkout.text2: Thank you for staying with us, and we wish you safe travels. We hope to see you again soon!
en.instructions.publictransport.heading: How to Use Public Transportation in Vienna
en.instructions.publictransport.text1: Vienna offers an excellent network of public transport, which allows you to move around the city quickly and easily. To find the best route, we recommend the Wiener Linien route planner.
en.instructions.publictransport.quote1:
Use the Wiener Linien route planner

Visit the official Wiener Linien route planner:
en.instructions.publictransport.quote2:
Start planning

Enter your current location (starting point) and choose the destination address "Absberggasse 6". The route planner will then show you the fastest and easiest connection to us or to another desired destination in Vienna.
en.instructions.publictransport.quote3:
Benefits of public transportation

- Frequency and coverage: Wiener Linien offers subway, tram and buses that take you to all parts of the city.

- Real time information: The route planner not only shows you the best connections, but also real-time information on departure times and possible delays.

- Practical for any occasion: Regardless of whether you come to us or want to get from A to B during your stay — you can get anywhere by public transport.
en.instructions.publictransport.quote4:
Tickets and prices

You can buy tickets for Wiener Linien at vending machines in subway stations, in tobacconists (kiosks), via VienMobil app or online at the Wiener Linien website. There are various ticket options, including single tickets, 24 and 48-hour tickets, and weekly passes.
en.instructions.publictransport.quote5:
Questions or help

If you have any questions about using the means of transport or need assistance planning your route, we will be happy to help you. Just talk to us!
en.instructions.publictransport.text2: With these instructions, you can reach your destination safely and easily and enjoy Vienna to the fullest.
en.instructions.baggagestorage_before.te: We understand that you may arrive in Vienna before our official check-in time at 2:00 PM and may not want to carry your luggage around all day. We are happy to offer you the option to safely store your luggage with us if your apartment is not yet ready.
en.instructions.baggagestorage_before.qu:
Luggage Drop-off Starting at 10:00 AM

Our cleaning staff will be on-site starting at 10:00 AM to prepare the apartments for incoming guests. You are welcome to enter the building and use the elevator to locate the cleaning staff. They always start from the top floors and work their way down, so we recommend starting your search on the upper floors and working your way down.

Inform the Staff

Once you find the cleaning staff, simply provide them with your apartment number, and they will be happy to assist you by securely storing your luggage until your apartment is ready for check-in.
en.instructions.baggagestorage_before.te: We hope this solution is convenient for you, and we look forward to welcoming you soon. If you have any further questions or need assistance, please don't hesitate to contact us.
en.instructions.baggagestorage_after.tex: You are welcome to leave your luggage with us after check-out. To ensure a smooth process, please follow the instructions below:
en.instructions.baggagestorage_after.quo: 🕘 Check-Out BEFORE 9:00 AM: Please make sure to inform us in advance if you plan to check out before 9:00 AM and leave your luggage. In that case, leave your luggage in the hallway of your apartment.

🕘 Check-Out AFTER 9:00 AM: Our cleaning staff will already be in the building and working their way from top to bottom. Please approach the cleaning team directly and hand over your luggage – they'll be happy to store it in the designated storage room for you.

🎒 Luggage pick-up: NO LATER THAN 2:45 PM: Please speak to the cleaning staff on the floors or in the ironing room on the ground floor. Do not enter any apartments yourself. After 2:45 PM, no staff will be on-site. Unfortunately, pick-up after this time is not possible. As an alternative, we recommend using luggage lockers at Vienna Central Station (Hauptbahnhof).
en.instructions.baggagestorage_after.tex: We hope this solution is convenient for you and helps make your stay as pleasant as possible. Should you have any further questions or need assistance, feel free to contact us.
en.instructions.heating.text1: You can easily control the temperature in your apartment with the Danfoss TPOne Thermostat. Follow these steps to adjust the heating system effectively. A detailed manual with images can also be downloaded as a PDF.
en.instructions.heating.quote1:
Turning the Heating On/Off

Press the power button on the thermostat to turn the heating on. For more detailed instructions with images, refer to the downloadable PDF guide.
en.instructions.heating.quote2:
Adjusting the Temperature

Use the arrow buttons on the display to increase or decrease the room temperature. The current temperature will be displayed.

Recommended temperatures: 21-22°C during the day, 18-19°C at night for optimal comfort.
en.instructions.heating.quote3:
Using the Comfort Modes

The thermostat has three modes:

- Home Mode: Ideal when you're in the apartment, maintaining a comfortable temperature.
- Away Mode: Use this when you're out to save energy.
- Sleep Mode: Set for a cooler night temperature.
en.instructions.heating.quote4:
Manual Temperature Adjustments

You can manually adjust the preset temperatures at any time. Just press the arrow buttons to set the temperature as needed.
en.instructions.heating.quote5:
Standby Mode

If you're away for an extended period, you can set the thermostat to Standby Mode.
en.instructions.heating.quote6:
Energy-Saving Features

Look for the leaf symbol, indicating an energy-saving setting.
en.instructions.heating.quote7:
Window Sensor

The thermostat will automatically switch to Standby Mode when a window is opened to save energy.
en.instructions.heating.text2: Tip: You can download the original manual with images here to learn how to use the thermostat effectively.
en.instructions.tv.text1: It may happen that previous guests have changed the TV settings.
en.instructions.tv.text2: Don't worry—it's quick and easy to restore the correct setting! In the PDF instructions, which you can download here, all steps are explained with pictures so that you can set up the TV according to your wishes in no time at all.
en.instructions.kids.text1: Vienna also has a lot to offer for families. When you're traveling with kids, it's often not the biggest to-do lists that are the best, but the places that are fun and yet remain relaxed. Here are a few family-friendly ideas for your stay in Vienna.
en.instructions.kids.quote1:
Schönbrunn is often a good choice with children

If you are looking for an excursion that is suitable for adults and children, Schönbrunn is a very nice option. There is not only the castle there, but also its own children's museum. In addition, the maze and the Labyrinthikon play area are among the offerings around Schönbrunn.
en.instructions.kids.quote2:
The Prater brings movement into the day

If kids want to let off steam, the Prater is often a good idea. According to the official Prater website, there are attractions for young and old, and the Vienna Ferris Wheel also offers family passes.
en.instructions.kids.quote3:
Technology and wonder in the museum

For days when you want to do something regardless of the weather, the Technical Museum can be very suitable. On the official site, there are special offers for children and families.
en.instructions.kids.quote4:
Experience Vienna from above

The Danube Tower can also be a special experience for older children. Officially, the Danube Tower advertises a 360-degree panoramic view of Vienna, and there is also a high-altitude slide there.
en.instructions.kids.quote5:
A short break in between

Especially with children, not only is the trip itself important, but also the time in between. LUNIMO fits very nicely: lovingly made music for children — with cheerful songs to sing along and quieter songs for relaxing moments.

💛🎵 Listen now on Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube, Amazon Music
en.instructions.kids.quote6:
Our tip for relaxing family days in Vienna

With children, you often don't have to see everything in Vienna. It is usually best to plan one or two good destinations per day and leave enough rest in between.
en.instructions.kids.text2: We wish you and your family a great time in Vienna and a relaxing stay with us.

You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority.

en.cookies.types.title: 2. Which cookies do we use?
en.cookies.types.essentialText: These cookies are technically required for the website to function. They cannot be disabled.
en.cookies.types.analyticsText: These cookies help us understand how visitors use our website. The data is evaluated anonymously.

en.cookies.types.thirdPartyText: For our booking functions we use external services such as Smoobu. These providers may set their own cookies.

en.agb.title: Terms & Conditions
en.agb.intro: These Terms & Conditions apply to all bookings and stays at Apartments zur Quelle.
en.agb.section1.title: 1. Scope
en.agb.section1.text: These Terms & Conditions apply to all bookings, stays, and services related to the holiday apartments Apartments zur Quelle. By completing a booking, the guest accepts these terms.
en.agb.section2.title: 2. Booking & Payment
en.agb.section2.paragraph1: A booking becomes binding once the guest completes the booking process and receives confirmation.
en.agb.section2.paragraph2: Payment is made in two steps: a 20% deposit at the time of booking (via Stripe or PayPal) and the remaining 80% no later than 7 days before arrival. If the remaining balance is not paid on time, we reserve the right to cancel the booking.
en.agb.section3.title: 3. Cancellation Policy
en.agb.section3.paragraph1: Up to 7 days before arrival (14:00), the deposit is refunded 100%.
en.agb.section3.paragraph2: From 7 days before arrival (14:00), a cancellation fee of 20% of the booking price applies (equal to the deposit). The deposit is non-refundable in this case.
en.agb.section3.paragraph3: In case of no-show without cancellation, the full amount is due.
en.agb.section4.title: 4. Check-in & Check-out
en.agb.section4.text: Access is via self check-in using a lockbox. The access code will be provided before arrival.
en.agb.section5.title: 5. House Rules
en.agb.section5.paragraph1: During the stay: maximum 2 guests, no smoking, no pets, no parties or events, quiet hours from 22:00–07:00, the apartment must be treated with care, and no unregistered visitors are allowed.
en.agb.section5.paragraph2: Before departure: gather used towels, switch off lights and appliances, rinse used dishes, return keys to the lockbox, and inform the host about checkout.
en.agb.section6.title: 6. Damages & Liability
en.agb.section6.paragraph1: The guest is liable for any damage caused during the stay by them or their companions. Damages must be reported immediately.
en.agb.section6.paragraph2: The host is not liable for loss of valuables, personal belongings of the guest, or interruptions caused by force majeure (e.g. power, internet).
en.agb.section7.title: 7. Safety
en.agb.section7.text: The apartment is equipped with a smoke alarm and a carbon monoxide alarm. Safety instructions must be followed.
en.agb.section8.title: 8. Privacy
en.agb.section8.text: For data protection information, please see our Privacy Policy.
en.agb.section9.title: 9. Jurisdiction
en.agb.section9.text: Exclusively Austrian law applies. Place of jurisdiction is Vienna.

en.cookies.section1.title: 1. What are cookies?
en.cookies.section1.text: Cookies are small text files stored on your device. They help us keep the website functional and improve your user experience.
en.cookies.section2.title: 2. Which cookies do we use?
en.cookies.section2.essential.text: These cookies are technically required for the website to function. They cannot be disabled.
en.cookies.section2.analytics.text: These cookies help us understand how visitors use our website. The data is evaluated anonymously.
en.cookies.section2.marketing.text: Marketing cookies allow us to show you relevant content and offers. These may be set by third parties.
en.cookies.section2.thirdparty.text: For our booking functions we use external services such as Smoobu. These providers may set their own cookies.
en.cookies.section3.title: 3. Legal basis
en.cookies.section3.text: Essential cookies are based on our legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). Analytics and marketing cookies are used only with your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR).
en.cookies.section4.title: 4. Change cookie settings
en.cookies.section4.text: You can change your cookie settings at any time via the cookie banner. If the banner is not displayed, you can delete cookies in your browser to have it displayed again.
